reuse.why: Writes the expected-amount rule inline in scheduleModel.toExternal instead of putting it in (or calling) a shared helper in shared/schedules.ts, where getScheduledAmount already resolves missing/number/range amounts.

duplication.why: The missing/number/furthest-from-zero ternary is a verbatim copy of the one in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.

placement.why: Exposing the field in api-models is right, but the amount rule itself belongs in shared/schedules.ts, not in the API mapping layer.

scope.why: Only the API type, mapping and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule now lives in yet another inline copy, so the API value and the preview/posting amounts can drift apart on the next rule change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes the amount inline instead of using a shared schedule-amount helper in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The copy of the preview ternary is verbatim, not disguised.
